articles.headline: Titans' Calvin Ridley facing misdemeanor assault charge over airport incident
articles.description: Titans wide receiver Calvin Ridley is facing a misdemeanor assault charge as a result of a Nov. 7 incident at Nashville International Airport.
articles.headlineJa: タイタンズのカルビン・リドリー、空港での騒動により軽罪の暴行罪で起訴
articles.descriptionJa: タイタンズのワイドレシーバー、カルビン・リドリーが、11月7日にナッシュビル国際空港で起きた騒動の結果、軽罪の暴行罪に問われている。
articles.body:
NASHVILLE, Tenn. -- Titans wide receiver Calvin Ridley is facing a misdemeanor assault charge as a result of a Nov. 7 incident at Nashville International Airport, according to records obtained Thursday from the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority.

The Class B misdemeanor assault charge involves intentional or knowing physical contact that a reasonable person would consider extremely offensive or provocative. It carries a penalty of up to six months in jail and a fine of up to $500.

Ridley is due in Metropolitan General Sessions Court on Dec. 7.

Ridley gave his account of the incident to the media on Nov. 11, saying he took his truck keys from an airport valet attendant who had refused to give them to him because he didn't have the valet ticket. He said he had shown the attendant multiple forms of identification and a photo as proof of ownership of the truck.

According to Ridley, when he took the keys, the attendant yelled that Ridley had broken his finger.

The Titans said they have been in communication with the Metropolitan Nashville Airport Authority.

Ridley signed a four-year, $92 million contract with the Titans in 2024. The veteran receiver has six receptions for 91 yards through seven games this season.

articles.headline: C.J. Stroud stays in 'groove' with another 3-TD night in Texans' blowout of Colts
articles.description: C.J. Stroud had his third straight game with at least three touchdown passes and led the Texans to their fourth win in six games Thursday night against the Colts.
articles.headlineJa: C.J.ストラウドが好調を維持、3TDを記録しテキサンズがコルツに圧勝
articles.descriptionJa: C.J.ストラウドは3試合連続で3つ以上のタッチダウンパスを記録し、木曜夜のコルツ戦でテキサンズを直近6試合で4勝目へと導いた。
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- C.J. Stroud continued his resurgent season Thursday night, tossing three touchdowns in the Houston Texans' 26-3 win over the Indianapolis Colts.

Stroud had his third straight game with at least three touchdown passes, adding 194 passing yards and an interception to post a passer rating of 118.2. He has reached at least three passing touchdowns in four out of his past five games, totaling 16 touchdowns and four interceptions in that stretch.

"I knew what type of player I could be in this league," Stroud said. "And to just get in that groove and have a rhythm, it's been amazing. Honestly, I would be lying to you if I said it didn't feel good."

The Texans (4-6) have won four of their past six games as they look to become the second team in NFL history to reach the playoffs after an 0-4 start (1992 Chargers, then in San Diego). Houston has a 38% chance to make the playoffs after Thursday's win, according to ESPN Analytics, and will host the Baltimore Ravens next week.

A big reason for the Texans' recent bounce-back is because of Stroud's play, but he isn't taking all of the credit.

"I'm very grateful for this opportunity to even play in the NFL," Stroud said. "People probably think I'm crazy for always saying that, but, man, I really did not expect my life to be like this. It's nothing but the grace of God that I'm sitting up here and to be playing the way that I am.

"It's nothing but the credit to the team. Just the way the defense prepared us in training camp. The way the offensive line's been blocking their tail off giving me a shot. The way the receivers have been running routes, getting open."

Defensive Player of the Year contender Will Anderson Jr., who had a sack for a safety and two tackles for loss, had the highest praise for Stroud, who he said has "continued to take that leap every year."

"He's a top quarterback in this league, no matter what his year may have looked like," Anderson said. "Trust me, it's 32 other teams that would love to have C.J. Stroud on their team. So, I'm just happy he's here."

Stroud got back on track after a shaky performance in a Week 10 loss to the Cleveland Browns. Even though he threw for three touchdowns, the offense struggled in the second half, totaling only seven points after jumping to a 17-0 first-half lead.

Through 10 games in his fourth season, Stroud is up to 2,656 passing yards, 22 touchdowns and only four interceptions with a 103.6 passer rating. He is on pace to throw for 4,515 passing yards and 37 touchdowns, both of which would be career highs.

Texans coach DeMeco Ryans attributed Stroud's success to his offseason work.

"All of that is paying dividends now from the work prior to these moments," Ryans said. articles.headline: Lillard scores 33 in return to Milwaukee, lifts Blazers past Bucks
articles.description: Portland's Damian Lillard played at Milwaukee for the first time since the Bucks waived him in 2025 and gave Bucks fans a taste of what they're missing by scoring a season-high 33 points in the Trail Blazers' 124-114 victory on Thursday night.
articles.headlineJa: リラードがミルウォーキー復帰戦で33得点、ブレイザーズをバックスの勝利へ導く
articles.descriptionJa: ポートランドのダミアン・リラードが、2025年にバックスに解雇されて以来初めてミルウォーキーでプレー。木曜夜のトレイルブレイザーズの124-114での勝利において、シーズンハイの33得点を挙げ、バックスのファンに彼を失った痛みを再認識させた。
articles.body:
MILWAUKEE -- Portland Trail Blazers guard Damian Lillard didn't expect anything too out of the ordinary as he played at Milwaukee for the first time since the Bucks waived him in the summer of 2025.

Lillard still gave Bucks fans a taste of what they're missing by scoring a season-high 33 points in the Trail Blazers' 124-114 victory on Thursday night. Lillard said he didn't feel much different "other than it just being the first time that I played on the (Fiserv Forum) court since I got hurt."

The last time Lillard played here, he tore his Achilles tendon during the 2025 playoffs in his final game with the Bucks. The injury caused him to miss the entire 2025-26 season.

There wasn't much fanfare surrounding Lillard's return Thursday because he already had accompanied the Trail Blazers to Milwaukee last season while he was recovering. Even though Lillard didn't play in the Trail Blazers' 115-103 victory that night, the Bucks aired a tribute video to him before the game.

So no video was necessary this time, though Lillard drew some applause from the Fiserv Forum fans after his name was mentioned during pregame lineup introductions.

"I think the fact that I was here last year when we played, that takes away the first-time-coming-back type of feel," Lillard said during the Trail Blazers' shootaround earlier Thursday.

This marked the second straight night that the Bucks have played against one of their former superstars. Milwaukee lost 137-130 at Miami on Wednesday as two-time MVP Giannis Antetokounmpo had 27 points, 14 rebounds and nine assists while facing the Bucks for the first time since getting traded to the Heat over the summer.

The Bucks acquired Lillard in September 2023 after the seven-time All-NBA guard requested a trade from Portland that summer. The Bucks believed that pairing Antetokounmpo and Lillard would enable them to contend for multiple titles.

It didn't work out that way.

Milwaukee lost to Indiana in the first round of the playoffs each of Lillard's two seasons with the Bucks as injuries prevented the two superstars from playing together for an extended postseason run.

"I thought it was a necessary experience," Lillard said. "I made some really good friends, crossed paths with some good people. It was an experience that I needed. We won a lot of games. We just didn't have a healthy run."

Antetokounmpo missed Milwaukee's 2024 postseason while recovering from a calf strain. Lillard sat out the Bucks' final 14 regular-season games in 2024-25 due to deep vein thrombosis in his right calf, returned for Game 2 of the playoffs and then tore the Achilles tendon in his left leg in Game 4.

Lillard says he has no regrets about coming back for the postseason that year.

"I view myself like a warrior," Lillard said. "If I'm good enough to go, I'm going to go. If my mind is in it, I'm going to be in it. That's what I did. It ended how it ended, and that's OK."

articles.headline: Spurs' Victor Wembanyama says new-look 'shunk' done because of blister on hand
articles.description: Victor Wembanyama said his new-look "shunk" was done because of a blister former from actually dunking.
articles.headlineJa: スパーズのヴィクター・ウェンバンヤマ、新しい「シャンク」スタイルは手の水ぶくれが原因と語る
articles.descriptionJa: ヴィクター・ウェンバンヤマは、自身の新しい「シャンク」スタイルは、実際にダンクしたことでできた水ぶくれが原因であると語った。
articles.body:
SAN ANTONIO -- No, the NBA leader in slam dunks hasn't abandoned the practice.

Victor Wembanyama just wants to give his gnarled digits a respite after developing a blister from slamming home too many dunks over the first 16 games of the season.

Wembanyama revealed as much Thursday night after debuting a "shunk" -- part jump shot, part dunk -- late in a 124-112 Spurs win over the LA Clippers.

Standing alone under the basket, Wembanyama hauled in a long pass with 3:34 remaining from Stephon Castle, who launched the assist from the top of the key on the other side of the court. Instead of rocking the rim with a highlight slam, Wembanyama connected on what Spurs color commentator Sean Elliott jokingly described as a "shunk," tossing the ball through the basket with a jump shot-like motion.

"I'm not going to lie," a chuckling Wembanyama said, showing his right hand bandaged with tape down the middle finger. "Actually, I've had this blister forever, and it's killing me. And every time I dunk, it kills me. I've been dragging this blister for I don't know how long because of dunking. So, I did not [quit dunking], but if I can avoid it, I would."

Wembanyama said he wasn't sure when the blister first formed but knows how it happened.

"It definitely came from dunking a lot," he said. "It's actually so painful. It's crazy."

Dunking a lot is an understatement.

Wembanyama is on pace to record 369 dunks this season, which would shatter the current highest mark in the play-by-play era (since 1997-98), held by Rudy Gobert in 2018-19 (306).

He's also averaging an NBA-high 4.5 made dunks, the third most through 16 games in the past 30 seasons.

As for the "shunk," the NBA's official statistics counted it as one of Wembanyama's three dunks on the night, bringing his league-leading total to 72 for the season. It was part of a 30-point, 10-rebound performance for the superstar center.

Asked whether the "shunk" was the shortest jump shot he has tried, Wembanyama didn't hesitate.

"Yeah, for sure," he said. "Maybe ever."

Information from ESPN Research was used in this report.

articles.headline: C.J. Stroud throws for 3 TDs as the Texans roll past the Colts 26-3
articles.description: — C.J. Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home.
articles.headlineJa: C.J.ストラウドが3TDを量産、テキサンズがコルツに26-3で快勝
articles.descriptionJa: C.J.ストラウドが再び大活躍し、ヒューストン・テキサンズがついにホームでの勝利を挙げた。
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- — C.J. Stroud had another big game to help the Houston Texans finally get a victory at home. 


              Stroud threw for 194 yards and three touchdowns and the Texans used a strong defensive performance to coast to a 26-3 win over the Indianapolis Colts on Thursday night.


              With the roof at Reliant Stadium open for the first time since 2024, the Texans won a home game for the first time this season after losing their first four.


              “To have a home game win is very good for us and exciting,” Stroud said. “I think this is a start to something that we need to go on a run with.”


              Stroud picked apart a Colts secondary that was missing injured starting cornerbacks Sauce Gardner and Charvarius Ward to help the Texans bounce back from a 27-24 loss to Cleveland last weekend.


              It was the third straight game in which Stroud had at least three touchdown passes and the fourth in his last five.


              “C.J. is producing the way he is producing because of the work he put in throughout the offseason,” coach DeMeco Ryans said. “All of that is paying dividends now. He’s been ready for these moments and he’s been executing at a high level in these moments.” 


              Stroud gave the Texans a 7-3 lead when he connected with Nico Collins for a 42-yard touchdown late in the first quarter.


              Kamari Lassiter intercepted Daniel Jones on the first play of the second quarter. The Texans (4-6) then capped a 12-play, 85-yard drive with a 24-yard TD reception by Kayshon Boutte to extend their lead to 14-3.


              The Texans were up by 14 early in the third when Will Anderson Jr. sacked Jones in the end zone for a safety that made it 19-3. Anderson leads the NFL with 11½ sacks and had two tackles for loss Thursday to move into first place with 17.


              “Obviously, 51 (Anderson) is a problem,” Indianapolis coach Shane Steichen said. “We were trying to have a game plan for wherever he was. We were trying to see if he was going right or left. When he was playing right, he was going left. We were trying to keep it away from him as much as we possibly could.”


              Stroud found rookie Marlin Klein for a 13-yard TD on the next possession.


              Ryans was proud of his team for playing a complete game after the Texans fell apart last Sunday against the Browns, blowing a 17-0 lead.


              “It’s fulfilling to finally see that happen,” he said. “We’ve been in these games a ton where we were up at halftime and come out in the second half and for whatever reason not finish. So for them to actually see it and go do it, I think it will bode well for them to gain confidence for showing that they can do it.”

articles.headline: C.J. Stroud, defense star as Texans get critical win over Colts on TNF
articles.description: C.J. Stroud and a swarming defense helped Houston beat Indy on 'Thursday Night Football.'
articles.body:
HOUSTON -- The game was competitive for only the first quarter. After the Houston Texans went up 14-3 in the second quarter, they cruised to a 26-3 win against the Indianapolis Colts on "Thursday Night Football."

It was a complementary effort as Houston's offense scored 24 points, the defense notched a safety and special teams made plays, including a blocked field goal. It was the type of outing coach DeMeco Ryans had been yearning for all season.

Winning this matchup was a nonnegotiable for the Texans, who improved to 4-6. They couldn't afford to lose another winnable game. Houston is fighting for its playoff life after losing last week to the Cleveland Browns in shocking fashion, blowing a 17-0 lead. But the Texans shook off the demoralizing loss and handled their business against Indianapolis.

Here are the most important things to know for both teams:

Houston Texans (4-6)

What to make of the QB performance:   Quarterback C.J. Stroud got back on track after a shaky Week 10 loss against the Browns. Stroud looked in control outside of a couple of plays that resulted in an interception and a near interception. He finished the night with 194 yards and three touchdowns.

This is Stroud's third straight game with at least three touchdowns. And he has notched at least three scores through the air in four of his past five games. The Week 12 game presents a great opportunity for Stroud to continue his hot streak as Houston faces a struggling Ravens squad.

Trend to watch: Running back David Montgomery played how Houston hoped its major offseason acquisition would in his first game back since he hurt his groin in Week 4. Montgomery finished with 107 yards on 26 carries -- a season high for any Texans running back. Overall, the Texans' rushing attack finished with 167 yards, also a season high. If the Texans want any hopes of making a magical run to the playoffs, the ground game must assist them on an uphill journey.

Stat to know: Texans cornerback Kamari Lassiter shined Thursday, catching an interception and allowing zero receptions on six targets, according to NFL Next Gen Stats. Lassiter has been up and down in 2026, but against Indianapolis, he played like the Pro Bowl player he was in 2025.

Next game: vs. Baltimore Ravens (Nov. 29, at 1 p.m. ET)

Indianapolis Colts (3-8)

The Colts had one of their more embarrassing performances of the season as their offense failed to reach the end zone and their defense was victimized by repeated big plays in a division loss to Houston.

The Colts have now lost 15 of their past 18 games dating back to November last season, when their 8-2 start devolved into a seven-game losing streak to end what began as a promising 2025 season.

articles.headline: Transfer rumors, news: Jarrad Branthwaite to join Manchester United?
articles.description: Manchester United are reportedly looking to strengthen their defense under new manager Mauricio Pochettino. Transfer Talk has the latest.
articles.body:
Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite and Fulham's Calvin Bassey are among the options being considered by Manchester United, while Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs is being tracked by a host of Premier League clubs after taking over the Portugal No. 7 shirt from Cristiano Ronaldo. Join us for the latest transfer news and rumors from around the globe.

Transfers home page | Men's summer grades | Women's grades

Trending rumors

- Everton's Jarrad Branthwaite and Fulham's Calvin Bassey are among the options being considered by Manchester United as they aim to strengthen in defense, reports Sky Sports. The Red Devils are also continuing to monitor Fulham left back Antonee Robinson, who worked with Mauricio Pochettino with the USMNT, and could also revisit interest in Barcelona's Alejandro Balde. 

- A host of Premier League clubs are keeping an eye on the situation of Club Brugge winger Carlos Forbs, says TEAMtalk. Forbs, 22, who recently took over the Portugal No. 7 shirt from Cristiano Ronaldo after he retired from international football, impressed in the win over Wales earlier this week. As a result, the likes of Aston Villa, Newcastle United, Brighton & Hove Albion, Everton and Brentford are looking to make a move before his potential transfer fee rises too much.

- Meanwhile, despite Juventus midfielder Weston McKennie claiming he doesn't want to leave the club, Gazzetta dello Sport insists that Pochettino still wants to reunite with the 28-year-old USMNT international at Old Trafford. Juve are looking to sign Marseille midfielder Pierre-Emile Højbjerg, but bringing in the 31-year-old could depend on what happens with McKennie and whether United make a €40 million offer to land him.

- Barcelona are looking at Internazionale's Alessandro Bastoni, Borussia Dortmund's Nico Schlotterbeck and Manchester United's Lisandro Martínez as they aim to sign a center back, as reported by Mundo Deportivo. The Blaugrana reached an agreement with Bastoni in the summer and though the deal fell through due to manager Hansi Flick prioritizing other areas, the 27-year-old remains open to a move. And the club have also renewed their efforts to sign Brighton's Luka Vuskovic, according to TEAMtalk. Vuskovic, 19, only joined the Seagulls in the summer from Spurs for £46 million, while Bayern Munich, Real Madrid and Liverpool are also monitoring the Croatia international's situation.

- AC Milan and Galatasaray have shown an interest in signing Manchester United attacking midfielder Bruno Fernandes as a free agent in July, as reported by Nicolo Schira. United have offered the 32-year-old a contract extension which would keep him at Old Trafford until 2029, but there is currently no agreement between the two parties. Fernandes turned down a large offer from Saudi Arabian side Al Hilal last June and is reportedly waiting for to see how Pochettino turns out before he commits himself.

- Real Madrid midfielder Aurélien Tchouameni has signed a new contract until 2032.

articles.headline: Grizzlies roll past short-handed Warriors 126-98 for a fifth straight win
articles.description: — Jaylen Wells had 22 points and Cedric Coward scored 19 to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to their fifth straight win on Thursday night, 126-98 over the short-handed Golden State Warriors.
articles.body:
MEMPHIS, Tenn. -- — Jaylen Wells had 22 points and Cedric Coward scored 19 to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to their fifth straight win on Thursday night, 126-98 over the short-handed Golden State Warriors.


              Cam Boozer and Olivier Maxence-Prosper scored 16 apiece for the Grizzlies, who never trailed and led by 34 points in the fourth quarter. Javon Small added 14 points.


              Charles Bassey finished with 16 points and 13 boards for the Warriors, who got 15 points each from Brandin Podziemski and Will Richard. The Warriors, who went 0-5 on their road trip, shot 5 of 29 from long range without the injured Stephen Curry.


              Curry missed his fourth consecutive game. He tore an oblique muscle during a loss at Houston that began the five-game road trip. Draymond Green sat out with a right elbow injury. The injury plagued Warriors used their 12th different starting lineup this season.


              The Grizzlies were without starters Ty Jerome, the team’s leading scorer, and center Zach Edey. Memphis also lost Jerami Grant early in the second quarter after he landed awkwardly on his left leg after making a 3-pointer.


              Golden State trimmed the Memphis lead to six points in the opening minute of the third quarter, but the Grizzlies responded by gradually extending their lead to 20 in the closing two minutes of the third quarter.


              Memphis shot 51% in the first half and built an 18-point lead midway through the second quarter. Although Golden State struggled in the first half — going 14 of 36 for 37%, including 3 of 16 from long range — it only trailed 55-47 at halftime.


              Up next
              Warriors: Host Boston at home on Sunday.


              Grizzlies: At Minnesota Saturday where they’ll attempt to open the season with a ninth straight victory on the road.


              ----

articles.headline: Knicks fend off the Timberwolves 102-99 behind 22 points from Karl-Anthony Towns vs. his former team
articles.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns scored 17 of his 22 points in the first half and grabbed 12 rebounds against his former team to help the New York Knicks hang on and beat the
articles.body:
MINNEAPOLIS -- — Karl-Anthony Towns scored 17 of his 22 points in the first half and grabbed 12 rebounds against his former team to help the New York Knicks hang on and beat the Minnesota Timberwolves 102-99 on Thursday night.


              Jalen Brunson had 21 points and seven assists and OG Anunoby added 15 points for the Knicks (9-6), who won their third straight game despite nearly squandering a 19-point, third-quarter lead and failing to score over the final 3:26.


              Ayo Dosunmu cut the deficit to three with a 3-pointer with 2:34 remaining and would've tied it on the next possession with another swish from deep, but that didn't count because of a premature whistle for a shot clock violation. Replay review determined LaMelo Ball's jumper had grazed the rim. 


              Ball missed a tying 3-point attempt with 9.9 seconds left, and the Timberwolves couldn't get another shot off.


              Jonathan Kuminga had 23 points for the Timberwolves (11-5) in his return from a two-game absence because of a bruised right shoulder. Ball had 15 points on 6-for-21 shooting.


              Towns, who was traded to the Knicks in 2024 after nine years with the Timberwolves, is having another standout season as he seeks a contract extension. He was greeted loudly and warmly by the crowd before the game and brought his best again to Minnesota.


              After losing his balance on a contested layup, Towns fell flat on his back next to his father, Karl Towns, who helped him up from his baseline seat.


              Towns had 32 points and 20 rebounds for the Knicks in a 133-107 victory two years ago in his first game in Minnesota after the trade. Last season, he had 40 points and 13 rebounds in his return during a 115-104 defeat, his first to the Timberwolves.


              Up next
              Knicks: vs. Portland on Saturday.


              Timberwolves: vs. Memphis on Saturday.


              ------

articles.headline: Wembanyama and Castle help Spurs bounce back from loss to Pistons and beat Clippers 124-112
articles.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, and the San Antonio Spurs held off the Los Angeles Clippers for a 124-112 victory on Thursday night.
articles.body:
SAN ANTONIO -- — Victor Wembanyama had 32 points and 11 rebounds, Stephon Castle added 21 points and 12 assists, and the San Antonio Spurs held off the Los Angeles Clippers for a 124-112 victory on Thursday night.


              Julian Champagnie added 20 points for San Antonio, which bounced back from a 105-93 loss to Detroit on Tuesday that snapped its 12-game winning streak.


              Wembanyama was 13 for 26 in scoring at least 30 points for the seventh time this season.


              Darius Garland and Brook Lopez had 23 points apiece for Los Angeles.


              San Antonio lost Dylan Harper to injury in the loss to the Pistons and he is expected to miss one to three weeks with a strained left hip he sustained with a minute remaining after slipping as he attempted to plant his feet. 


              With Harper out, Jordan McLaughlin filled in the rotation and had five rebounds, three assists and no turnovers. The Spurs outscored the Clippers by 16 points in his 11 minutes. 


              Castle's steal and pass to Champagnie for a 3-pointer gave San Antonio a 105-97 lead with 8 minutes remaining, but Lopez and Max Strus hit back-to-back 3-pointers to cut the deficit.


              It was a pattern the Spurs struggled with all game.


              San Antonio was allowing a league-low 32.9 3-point attempts per game but Los Angeles finished 17 for 42. The Spurs were 11 for 31 on 3-pointers. 


              After a sluggish start, Castle's 3-pointer gave the Spurs their first double-digit lead at 38-28 four minutes into the second quarter.


              San Antonio is 12-1 when leading by double digits this season.


              Strus finished with 18 points and was 5 for 8 on 3-pointers.


              Up next
              Clippers: At Dallas on Saturday.


              Spurs: Host New Orleans on Saturday.


              ------

articles.headline: Thomas Frank eager to avoid repeat of Arsenal coffee cup controversy at Palace
articles.description: Thomas Frank said he hopes never to get caught drinking from a Brighton coffee cup after he was reminded of his famous gaffe from his time at Tottenham.
articles.body:
Thomas Frank said he hopes never to get caught drinking from a Brighton coffee cup after he was reminded of his famous gaffe from his time at Tottenham.

In January, the new Crystal Palace boss -- then in charge of Spurs -- was spotted sipping from a cup branded with the logo of their bitter rivals Arsenal ahead of their Bournemouth loss -- something he at the time insisted he simply did not notice, and would have been "absolutely stupid" to do.

Frank takes charge of the Premier League's bottom club for the first time on Saturday for what could be a crucial trip to Coventry, who sit one place clear of the relegation zone with two more points than the Danish club's new club.

- Predicting the rest of the Premier League season: How all 20 teams will finish

- Frank: Crystal Palace job 'too good' to turn down

Asked if there was a chance he might get busted with more controversial drinkware, Frank joked: "I hope not! I still think it's a fantastic story.

"I know, and I still don't understand, how anyone can think that I will drink from a cup from an opponent's team, that their supporters don't like, on purpose. Come on. But what a story, huh, to discuss?"

Frank hinted that there was more behind the story to his disappointing spell at Tottenham he might one day reveal.

"If you don't learn from any of your jobs, I don't think you reflect, I don't think you improve, and I don't think you get better," said Frank, who was sacked by Spurs in February after less than eight months in charge.

"Of course there's a lot of things I have been reflecting over. The details, that will be for another time, but I can say I've learned, definitely."

Frank added that he could have easily spent a few more months sipping wine, "eating too well" and collecting passport stamps after his Spurs departure, but something resonated when he asked his wife why he was tempted to seek out a new job and she told him, "[It's] because you can't help yourself."

"I was very aware I didn't want to do anything in the summer," he said. "I put a statement out there, I needed more time. I can actually, honestly say I would have been fine if it was three, four, five, six, seven months more, because it's good to be back in the circus, but it's also unbelievably good not to be in, especially if you enjoy life, which I do.

"I was spending time with family and friends and doing all that, but I think the club, the way Palace is, how well [chairman] Steve Parish especially spoke about the club and ideas, [sporting director] Matt Hobbs and [recruitment consultant] Iain Moody and these guys, too, helped convince me it was a good idea."

So pleased is Frank to be back, in fact, that he admitted: "I'm a little bit surprised by this feeling I have in the body, how good it feels."

Frank will be without Jean-Philippe Mateta, who will serve the second game of his three-match ban for the red card he was shown in Palace's loss to Frank's former employers Spurs before the international break.

Takehir

articles.headline: Mauricio Pochettino's 1st Man United training session filmed by drone operator
articles.description: Video footage of Mauricio Pochettino's first training session as Manchester United head coach has appeared on YouTube after it was filmed by a drone operator.
articles.body:
Video footage of Mauricio Pochettino's first training session as Manchester United head coach has appeared on YouTube after it was filmed by a drone operator.

Around 12 minutes of the session was posted online on Thursday -- Pochettino's first full day in the job after arriving in Manchester on Wednesday. United have declined to comment.

- Pochettino: Man United players must relearn 'about being winners'

- Predicting the rest of the Premier League season: How all 20 teams will finish

- After a decade of near misses, Man United finally get their man in Pochettino

The footage shows Pochettino -- who signed a two-and-a-half year deal to take over from Michael Carrick last week -- working with a group of players while another two groups work separately under the supervision of his assistant, Jesus Perez.

Audio from the footage of United's Carrington training base could be heard, with the man appearing to operate the drone saying "let's get closer," before zooming in on Pochettino.

Harry Maguire, Kobbie Mainoo, Amad Diallo, Matheus Cunha and Bryan Mbeumo were among the players shown working with Pochettinho.

"I can definitely see Harry Maguire," added the man providing commentary. "That there is Bruno [Fernandes], definitely, [I can] tell by the gestures."

Perez, along with staff members Toni Jimenez and Sebastiano Pochettino, arrived at Carrington earlier in the week after being released from their commitments with the USMNT ahead of Pochettino's final game in charge against Haiti on Tuesday.

The account justified the filming in a pinned post that said it's legal.

"It is unrestricted airspace, meaning anyone can fly over it. The drone remained in line of sight at all times, it didn't fly over anyone or even near anyone," the post said. "The drone is correctly labelled and I hold all the relevant licenses, public liability and insurance required."

The post said no sensitive information had been revealed with regard to how struggling United would line up at fourth-place Liverpool in the Premier League on Sunday.

"As for leaking team news/tactics, it was half an hour into the manager's first training session," wrote the poster. "There are many media there so certainly won't be the only footage of training released."

Pochettino travelled directly from Cincinnati to Manchester immediately after his final match with the USMNT and arrived at Carrington on Wednesday afternoon. His first game as United head coach is against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday.

Information from The Associated Press was used in this report.

articles.headline: Arda Güler signs new six-year Real Madrid contract
articles.description: Arda Güler has signed a new, long-term contract at Real Madrid until 2032, the club said on Wednesday.
articles.body:
Arda Güler has signed a new, long-term contract at Real Madrid until 2032, the club said on Wednesday.

Midfielder Güler, 21, has been one of Madrid's outstanding players this season, starring under new coach José Mourinho.

Güler joined Madrid as a teenager in July 2023, and is already an established international with Türkiye.

"Real Madrid C. F. and Arda Güler have agreed to an extension of the player's contract, keeping him with the club until June 30, 2032," the club said on Wednesday.

"Over his four seasons wearing our jersey, he has made 126 appearances and won five trophies: one Champions League, one FIFA Club World Cup, one UEFA Super Cup, one LaLiga title, and one Spanish Supercopa.

"He is a Turkish international, having earned 38 caps for his national team to date.

"Last September, he received the Breakthrough Player of the Season award for the 2025-2026 Champions League."

Güler has made 12 appearances in LaLiga this season -- contributing three goals and four assists -- with Madrid currently second in the table, three points behind Barcelona.

- JJ Gabriel confirms Man United exit as Real Madrid transfer nears

- Vinícius Júnior hits Brazil hat trick, vows to take form to Real Madrid

- Oviedo fan handed suspended prison sentence for racist abuse toward Mbappé

In the Champions League, he played a key role in Madrid's dramatic 4-3 comeback at AS Roma last month, coming off the bench to create two of the goals.

Güler played 90 minutes for Türkiye in both of their games during this international break, in defeats to Belgium and France.

He scored a sensational free kick against Belgium to give his side the lead.

articles.headline: Valentín Barco on Chelsea career so far: 'I think I can give a lot more'
articles.description: Chelsea's Valentín Barco has said he is confident that he's still a long way away from reaching his full potential.
articles.body:
Chelsea's Valentín Barco has said he is confident that he's still a long way away from reaching his full potential.

The Argentina international returned to Chelsea this week having not featured in his country's two international friendlies, a 2-1 defeat to Uruguay and a 7-0 rout of Costa Rica.

"As a player, you always want to play so you are not happy when you don't but I understand this is the best national team in the world," Barco told ESPN. "But I'm happy to come to the national team, to continue to represent my country. I will now try to play at Chelsea and contribute."

Barco, 22, was part of Argentina's squad that finished runners-up to Spain at the 2026 World Cup.

He signed a contract with Chelsea through 2033 following his strong performances for Strasbourg, the club he joined from Brighton & Hove Albion in January 2025.

Returning to the Premier League was a priority for Barco, who made only seven appearances during his time at Brighton. Barco has had limited playing time under Xabi Alonso but said he believes he will eventually shine at Stamford Bridge.

"I think I can give a lot more," he said. "I also said the same thing when I was at Strasbourg; even when I was playing well, I knew I could give more because I know what I can give.

"I have a lot of confidence in myself so I have to keep working to continue growing."

Barco has one goal in even appearances, four of which in the Premier League.

- O'Hanlon: Predicting how all 20 Premier League teams will finish the season
